utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah—main bits are school lot at 9, and if you’re dropping early, leave it on Leo’s porch before 6 with a note on anything weird.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep repeating that: school lot at 9, or Leo’s porch before 6 with a note if anything’s odd.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s the gist—thanks for passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Faye, quick update—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center; if you can, could you help me confirm who’s bringing tools and who still needs repairs?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa—I can do that after school drop-off, and I’ll start letting folks know it’s Sunday at the community center while I check who’s bringing tools and who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Faye—that helps a lot; send me what you hear after drop-off, and I’ll fold it into the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam, I think it’s this Saturday at 9 in the school parking lot—I just can’t remember if I’m meant to bring tools too, or only the cords and little appliances.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: If you’re already bringing the cords and little appliances, I’d stick with that unless Leo or Gus asked for tools too. I’m set to handle the basic tool setup when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s a relief—thanks, Sam. I’ll bring the cords and little appliances then, and try not to overthink it this time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah—repair drive’s set for Saturday afternoon, focused on bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture; if you’re free, I’d love your help checking the small appliances table.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—that matches what I had, so yeah, I can help with the small appliances table Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Noah—thanks; we’ll have you on small appliances Saturday afternoon, and I’ll loop you in if anything shifts before then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still telling people it’s Saturday afternoon for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, and I’m only getting a rough headcount so far.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—I’m still out running errands, so keep me posted this afternoon on the headcount and what gets confirmed for pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do—I’ll keep gathering a rough headcount and send you an update this afternoon once I hear anything firmer about pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, if you see anyone nearby, send them over and let them know the repair drive’s running all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—I’ll send folks to my porch and let them know it’s running all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—if the Millers or Jo come by, send them along too and remind them we’ll be fixing things all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s still Saturday afternoon, and I only know the folding tables need repair and Sam’s bringing the basic tools. If you want, you could help Gus set up tables while Rosa confirms the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll head over and help Gus set up the tables while Rosa checks on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, the repair drive’s really taking off—folks have been dropping off tools all morning, and I’m planning to tell the Millers after lunch and Jo too if I catch her out front.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—I’d only heard bits and pieces, so I’ll keep asking around about who still needs repairs and make sure Rosa gets the names.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d help a lot, Nell—if Rosa gathers a few names, I can mention them when I stop by the Millers’ after lunch and keep Jo in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, can you confirm today what else still needs fixing and exactly which tools Sam is bringing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure—Sam said he’s bringing the basic tools, and besides that the folding tables still need repair; I’m sorting the rest today and I’ll confirm anything else that turns up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—confirm by this afternoon what else needs fixing, and get Sam to list the exact tools, not just 'basic tools.'

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, I’m keeping the repair list up to date, and I’ll have a clear status update for everyone this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—that helps; before I lock anything in, are we still confirmed for Saturday afternoon and just bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Saturday afternoon is still the plan, and we’re keeping it to bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture. I’ll note that on the list and include it in the update this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, a quick rundown would help—I only know about the folding tables and Sam’s basic tools so far.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right now it’s the folding tables plus whatever neighbors bring by, and Sam’s got the basic tools covered—we’ll be at it all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll keep passing that along quietly: folding tables, whatever neighbors bring, and all afternoon Saturday with Sam covering the basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Sunday at the community center, and I’m still waiting on a fresh porch drop-off time for Leo.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually sure it’s happening, and who directly confirmed Sunday and the pickup details?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa directly confirmed the move to Sunday at the community center, and I don’t have a current Leo porch drop-off time confirmed yet.
